excerpt.text: Currently, BTC, ETH, SOL, EURC, XRP, ADA, cbETH, DOGE HBAR, LINK, AAVE, NEAR, TAO, HYPE, PAXG, and USDT can be used as collateral in addition to USDC.

primary_coinbase_sources.claim: Coinbase Global Exchange lists XRP as an accepted collateral asset alongside USDC and other assets.

excerpts.text: There are limits on how much of an asset can be used as collateral across your organization (UBO). These limits are calculated as a percentage of the average daily quantity (ADQ) of the asset. Exceeding a limit means the excess collateral above the limit does not contribute to portfolio value.

Collateral Value is calculated by multiplying notional value by collateral weight. Collateral weight is 1 minus collateral haircut. The greater of the base haircut and closeout horizon haircut is applied.

primary_coinbase_sources.claim: Collateral use is constrained by per-UBO average-daily-quantity limits and haircuts; excess above the ADQ cap does not contribute to portfolio value, and collateral may be liquidated when margin falls below maintenance.

collateral_interpretation.confirmed: XRP is an accepted collateral asset on Coinbase Global Exchange/INTX perpetual-futures accounts.
constraints: Per-UBO collateral caps are based on average daily quantity.
Collateral value is reduced by haircuts; the greater of base and closeout-horizon haircut applies.
Collateral can be liquidated if margin falls below maintenance.
unknowns: No XRP-specific haircut or ADQ cap value was captured.
No actual XRP collateral balances, utilization, concentration or client-level exposure were disclosed.
The Global Exchange collateral policy must not be transferred to Coinbase's US CFM/CBI product without a separate source.
collateral_interpretation.demand_conclusion: Accepted collateral creates a potential utility channel but is not evidence that customers have posted XRP, that XRP is locked, or that net spot demand increased.

limitations: Loris is a secondary aggregator, not a direct Coinbase market-data receipt.
The Coinbase US XRP row is more than 14 hours old at capture.
The Loris aggregate page is more than 86 minutes old at capture.
The 40-venue universe is not comparable to seven-exchange trackers or narrower providers.
The $21.65M versus $22.7M Coinbase US XRP OI difference is not averaged.

source_independence.independence_note: Coinbase's product pages are multiple documents from one issuer and are not independent confirmations. Loris's aggregate and exchange-specific pages are one aggregator family, not two independent sources.

reasons: Collateral availability is not observed collateral usage or an XRP flow.

The Loris Coinbase row is stale secondary data.
The official Coinbase US XPP expiry documents conflict.
